race.comment: COLLATED (4) hasn't quite been able to meet expectations since resuming but should be hitting his straps third-up and the mile looks perfect for him now. Drawn sticky but Murtagh should have a good feel for him now. STRATUM PRIDE (8) never looked likely last time at headquarters but had been going okay without winning prior to that. If they can hold a spot from the low draw, she's good enough on her day to take this out. BELLE FROM HELL (11) is desperate to break through soon but continues to leave herself with too much to do in the run home. Will likely drift back again so watch for her late. FLYWAY (15) is going better than his form reads and doesn't need to improve much to be right there at the business end. HALLSTATT (9) is a tough one to catch but is up to this on his best form. One for the exotics.
